# District Q3 Sales Contest

- **Goal / definition of done:** win (or place) in the **District 7** Q3 contest — the metric is **comp-sales
  growth** and **Summit Rewards sign-up rate** over the quarter.
- **Owner:** [Renata Vasquez](../people/renata-vasquez.md) (DM) runs it; Marc competes on behalf of #4172.
- **Status:** **live**, launched at the **2026-07-10** district visit; runs through the quarter.
- **Standing:** Northgate is **narrowly behind [Priya Nair](../people/priya-nair.md)'s Westfield store** on
  comp; ahead of the district average on loyalty sign-ups thanks to Tanya's front-end.
- **Levers Marc's pulling:** push Summit Rewards at the register, feature high-comp footwear on the
  [Endcap Reset — Summer](../projects/endcap-reset-summer.md), and coach UPT at checkout.
- **Prize:** bragging rights plus a team pizza/gift-card budget for the winning store.
